text:
oncall-bot: P0 page: GPU capacity exhaustion + autoscaler failures in us-west-2. Queue growing, throttles increasing. Paging oncall.

Alex P: ack — I'm looking. seeing steady queue growth on /generate: pending=1.9k, inflight=80, tokens/s down ~40%.

Maria G: same, metrics: 429s spiking for customers on dedicated pools. autoscaler reports attempted_scale=3 but failed placements due to MIG layout.

Kevin L: logs from scheduler: `NoFitError: insufficient contiguous MIG slices for requested instance type` + `BinpackFailed: fragmentation prevents allocation`

SchedulerBot: scheduler decision summary: nodes_available=24, nodes_fragmented=12, free_mig_slices=18, request_slots_needed=24. Preferred binpack strategy prevents split across nodes.

Jess T: quick customer-impact check? CS reports 3 enterprise customers on Dedicated experienced degradations (request timeouts -> retry storms). CS-Eden: true, threads from AcmeData and Shopwise, both saw 503 for 8-12m.

Alex P: mitigation plan idea: 1) temporarily relax binpack strictness to allow cross-node placement, 2) trigger fallback model (quantized-7b) on high-latency routes, 3) mark stranded nodes for manual defrag. Doing 1 now.

SRE Runbook Bot: Playbook invoked: "gpu-autoscale-fragmentation". Recommended steps: toggle binpack->best-fit, evict lower-priority jobs, scale to larger instance family.

Maria G: toggled binpack to best-fit: scheduler restarted. New allocations starting but still some failures because several nodes have mixed MIG sizes (1g+2g slices) — not enough contiguous for 4g requests.

Alex P: rolling traffic fallback: pushing route override to route-service to map heavy customers to quantized-7b; patching config now.

Kevin L: attempted to drain 3 partially-used nodes to free contiguous slices; drain stuck due to long-running kv-cache sessions. Executing `kubectl drain` with force for those pods.

Alex P: manual scale request to cloud: requested +4 x p4d-like instances (bigger GPUs, no MIG fragmentation). Cloud console shows quota soft-limit; opened support ticket and escalated to account manager.

CS-Eden: notifying affected customers with status page note that we're mitigating (no data exfiltration). message drafted, will send after first mitigation step succeeds.

Jess T: monitoring after binpack change + fallbacks: queue shrank from 1.9k -> 600 in 7m, throttles down but 5xx still > baseline. Keep second mitigation active.

Alex P: note: some capacity is stranded on nodes with odd MIG partitions created by older onboarding scripts (1x2g + 2x1g). Need housekeeping to standardize MIG templates.

Kevin L: extracted scheduler debug dump:
```
node-id: i-0abc
mig-layout: [2g,1g,1g]
free-slices: [0,0,1]
pending-request: 4g
decision: NoFit
```

Maria G: starting a quick runbook task: list all nodes with mixed-MIG layouts and tag them `stranded` for manual reprovisioning. Running query now.

SRE Runbook Bot: tagging complete: nodes_tagged=9. Suggest follow-up: schedule rolling reprovision with standard MIG profile (4g or 2g only).

Alex P: handoff — I need to step off for infra meeting in 20m. Jess, Kevin you two take lead. I'll be reachable.

Jess T: taking lead. Action items: (A) continue scale+drain until queue stable, (B) keep fallback route active for 30m, (C) coordinate cloud quota escalation.

Kevin L: will run batch job to compact small MIG slices into standard profiles where possible (requires node reboot). plan: cordon, drain, reprovision, uncordon — doing in small batches (2 nodes at a time).

Maria G: CS note sent to customers: "We're actively mitigating GPU capacity issues; we've routed traffic to fallback models and expect recovery within 30-60 minutes. We'll follow up with a root cause and timeline."

CS-Eden: some customers asked for SLA credit assessment. Recording impacted request counts per customer for follow-up.

Jess T: status update: queue at 220 -> still trending down. new allocations successful on best-fit change. However autoscaler attempted additional scaling but cloud API returned `QuotaExceeded`. Cloud ticket updated with high priority.

SchedulerBot: autoscaler state: desired_replicas=48, current_replicas=40, scale_attempts=4, last_error=QuotaExceeded.

Alex P: returning. Quick ask: can we patch autoscaler to fall back to launching different instance family (non-MIG) for short term? If yes, do it.

Kevin L: we have a feature flag to allow non-MIG launches for emergency — toggled it. Triggering scale again.

SRE Runbook Bot: new nodes provisioned: +3 larger GPUs. scheduler placed 18 pending requests onto them. queue now 40.

Jess T: Great. Next: schedule postmortem and action items: 1) enforce standard MIG templates for new nodes, 2) add scheduler resilience to logically defragment (allow split placement + stitching cache), 3) autoscaler enhancement: graceful fallback to different instance types on quota errors, 4) run a defrag job monthly to remove stranded capacity.

Alex P: assigning owners: (1) Maria, (2) Kevin + Eng-Scheduler, (3) Alex, (4) SRE program.

CS-Eden: closing customer comms loop: will send a follow-up with timeline and credit process after internal RCA.

Jess T: on-call handoff note: I'm on for next 2 hours; then Kevin takes over. If anyone else gets paged, ping me with @Jess_T.

oncall-bot: Incident resolved (mitigation stable): queue < 50, throttles normalizing, cloud quota escalated, nodes being reprovisioned. Incident severity: P0 -> degraded->monitoring.

Kevin L: marking thread for postmortem. I'll capture logs and scheduler dumps.

Alex P: thanks everyone.
